text: Theory: a Hadamard on qubit 0 followed by CNOT(0,1) makes a Bell state, so only 00 and 11 appear, about half each.
hypothesis: H(0) then CX(0,1) prepares the Bell state (|00> + |11>)/sqrt(2)
script:
q.circuit new bellth 2
q.circuit add h 0
q.circuit add cx 0 1
q.circuit run shots 4000 basis z
